cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. They're calling your audition number. Do you want the part enough to let them hear you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want it. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I can walk you in or drive you home. Which want am I helping?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Is that enough to risk the audition, or are we going home?

mechanism: A uses familiar audition preparation to force its pupil to choose the part with emotional risk or safety without performing.
confusable: Not promising confidence will guarantee success: A explicitly refuses to guarantee audience kindness.
seedUse: D106 number/laugh/walk/home; S05 vocal coaching and familiar preparation.
